description: Spec-compliant boilerplate for an agent-facing file, filled with your domain: ard (and ai-catalog-well-known-file), llms-txt, agents-md, mcp-server-cards (SEP-2127), a2a (agent card 1.0), ai-crawler-tokens-robots, api-catalog-rfc9727, security-txt, auth-md. Input: id; optional domain, name, description, mcp_url, api_url, agent_url, contact. Returns target_path, content_type, recommended_headers, contents, the fields to edit, notes on the specification, and the validate_manifest call to run once it is live.

agent_url.description: absolute https URL of the A2A endpoint

api_url.description: absolute https URL of the OpenAPI description

contact.description: mailto:, https: or tel: URI (a bare email gets mailto:)

domain.description: bare hostname the file is for, e.g. example.com (default example.com)

id.description: one of ard, ai-catalog-well-known-file, llms-txt, agents-md, mcp-server-cards, a2a, ai-crawler-tokens-robots, api-catalog-rfc9727, security-txt, auth-md

mcp_url.description: absolute https URL of the MCP endpoint

name: template
